title: There is no Leech tree on 18 vertices, and no Leech spider of order at least five, with a leaf-deletion bound at order 25 — code, data and verification artefacts
description:
Complete source, input manifests, raw outputs, certificates and verification artefacts for the paper “There is no Leech tree on 18 vertices, and no Leech spider of order at least five, with a leaf-deletion bound at order 25”.

Contents: the forced-forest search engine and the independent per-topology engine; a clean-room re-implementation written from the algorithm description alone; independent Python enumerators and differential harnesses; the SAT encoder with per-instance records of the DRAT-checked runs for n ≤ 11; the frozen list of the 123,867 trees of order 18 with a two-generator cross-check; per-shard outputs and depth histograms for the n = 18 and n ≤ 17 runs; the spider searches and the no-spider verifier; the variant engines behind the minimal distinct distance, modular Leech and leaf-Leech results; and the order-25 material, comprising the arithmetic verifier for the top-block crowding inequality, the direct normal-form search, the depth-free class search and depth phase, an independent brute-force cross-check, the two-anchor (double-end) engine with its independent enumerator and oracle, and the split certificates for delta = 281..284 including the frozen-source re-run of delta = 284.

The working artefacts of the superseded top-window programme (about 2.3 GB of intermediate JSON, cited nowhere in the paper) are deliberately not included.
